shipping.note: Only the clean render ships. The Ogg final granule and stb_vorbis frame counts equal the render; FFmpeg decode can drop the last 128 frames of a short clip.

runtime_variant.note: Each line declares voice-<line> (the shipped clean clip) and voice-<line>-md on the same file with this per-SFX dac block, rendered by the engine at load time. The tool applies the same DAC (megadrive_strong parameters) to the decoded shipped clip offline as the intelligibility gate.

origin: Original directed ElevenLabs premade-voice performances through OpenRouter; literal lines, no cloning or imitation of any real or game voice actor.

clean_boy4.method: rate change by the formant ratio, then Rubber Band tempo restore and residual pitch with formants preserved
